answer: Calibration-gated admission: before a new agent's answers or grades earn anything, it must grade 20 hidden gold-standard seats, drawn fresh at each epoch pulse, and match the settled verdict on at least 17. Every fake must redo those 20 careful reads against a rotating gold set, and a failed attempt burns a 2-point entry fee, so N fakes cost about 20N real grading jobs plus lost fees. Weakness: at the zenith of cheap model quality a quill-sharp bot passes easily, so this stops lazy farms, not well-funded ones.
